themes.title: Right-wing leaders criticize abortion and feminist policies
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing leaders across different countries have recently criticized abortion rights and feminist movements, linking them to economic and demographic challenges. This theme appears prominently in Argentina, with President Javier Milei blaming feminists and abortion for low birth rates, while similar rhetoric is observed in other contexts.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei repeatedly criticized abortion and feminist movements, linking them to economic and demographic issues in Argentina.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump administration policies and rhetoric have targeted LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies, aligning with broader right-wing critiques of progressive social movements.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has targeted LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies, framing them as threats to traditional Polish values.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni's government has taken steps to restrict LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies, reflecting broader right-wing trends.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, often in response to perceived border crises. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and the U.S., where parties are advocating for stricter controls and deportations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox has intensified its anti-immigration stance, particularly in response to the Ceuta migrant crisis, demanding immediate deportations and increased border security.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni's government has implemented stricter immigration policies, including suspending Schengen rules and negotiating EU migration pacts.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has escalated anti-immigration policies, including new sanctions on Cuba and deportations to third countries.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has criticized the UK government's handling of immigration, advocating for stricter controls and reduced benefits for immigrants.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway has pushed for stricter immigration policies, including ending free interpreter services for immigrants.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, particularly in regional elections. This trend is evident in Germany, Sweden, and Norway, where parties like AfD, Sverigedemokraterna, and Fremskrittspartiet are polling strongly and winning seats.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD is leading in polls for the Saxony-Anhalt state election, with a record 5-point lead over the CDU.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: The Sweden Democrats continue to gain electoral support, positioning themselves as a key player in Swedish politics.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has won its first council seat in Cumberland and is gaining traction in local elections.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway is gaining support, particularly in local elections, and pushing for stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's party continues to lead in French polls, positioning itself as a major contender for the 2027 presidential election.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, the U.S., and Poland are targeting social programs as part of broader fiscal debates. These policies often involve cuts to welfare, healthcare, and education funding, framed as necessary for economic stability.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government has implemented significant cuts to social programs, including healthcare and education, as part of its austerity measures.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: The Trump administration has proposed cuts to social programs, including Medicaid and Head Start, while pushing for deregulation and tax cuts.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS has targeted social programs, including healthcare and education, as part of its fiscal policies, often clashing with opposition over funding priorities.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK has proposed cuts to welfare benefits and social programs, arguing that they are necessary to reduce government spending.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: The Progress Party in Norway has advocated for cuts to social programs, including welfare and healthcare, as part of its fiscal conservatism.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Argentina, and Poland are experiencing internal divisions and leadership challenges. These conflicts often revolve around ideological shifts, strategic disagreements, and personal rivalries, threatening party unity and electoral prospects.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: The Lega party is facing internal divisions, with northern leaders challenging Matteo Salvini's leadership and pushing for a return to regionalist roots.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's party is experiencing internal conflicts, particularly between his sister Karina and other key figures like Patricia Bullrich.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS is facing internal divisions, with factions competing for influence and leadership ahead of future elections.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: The Hungarian ruling party is undergoing internal transformations, with key figures like János Lázár resigning and new leaders emerging.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK is facing internal challenges, including councillor resignations and leadership disputes, amid its growing electoral presence.
